topics.title: Allah ek hai
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Suno! Aaj hum 'Allah ek hai' seekhenge — adab aur pyar ke sath.

## SAMJHAO
Grade 1 ke liye asaan baat: Allah ek hai. Yeh Islam ki khoobsurat taleem hai. Key points: Ek, Khaliq, Rahman, Rabb.

## MISAAL
Islamabad / ghar / school mein isay amal mein lao — jaise Ek aur Khaliq.

## KARO
Aaj ek kaam: Allah ek hain — Tauheed. Phir family ko batao ke aapne kya seekha.

## SAWAAL
1) Allah ek hai ka matlab kya hai?
2) Aap ghar mein isay kaise amal karoge?
3) Ek misaal do.
